mapper.select: SELECT english_level FROM learner_profile WHERE subject_key=#{subject}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learner_answer_evidence(turn_id,subject_key,session_id,outcome,candidate_level,confidence,eligible,observed_at) VALUES(#{turn},#{subject},#{session},#{outcome},#{candidate},#{confidence},#{eligible},#{at}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE turn_id=turn_id
mapper.select: SELECT e.turn_id AS turnId,e.subject_key AS subjectKey,e.session_id AS sessionId,e.outcome, e.candidate_level AS candidate,e.confidence,e.eligible,UNIX_TIMESTAMP(e.observed_at)*1000 AS observedAt FROM learner_answer_evidence e JOIN training_session s ON s.id=e.session_id JOIN learner_profile p ON p.subject_key=e.subject_key WHERE e.subject_key=#{subject} AND s.status='CLOSED' AND e.observed_at >= #{since} AND (p.last_promoted_at IS NULL OR e.observed_at > p.last_promoted_at) ORDER BY e.observed_at DESC LIMIT 500
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation_teaching_reply SET completed=1,spoken_text=#{text} WHERE turn_id=#{turn} AND reply_id=#{reply} AND completed=0
mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS turnId,t.user_text AS userText,r.spoken_text AS assistantText, (r.practice_input=1 OR COALESCE(s.scenario_id,'free') != 'free') AS practiceInput FROM conversation_turn t JOIN conversation_teaching_reply r ON r.turn_id=t.id JOIN training_session s ON s.id=t.session_id JOIN learner_profile p ON p.subject_key=r.subject_key WHERE r.subject_key=#{subject} AND r.session_id=#{session} AND r.completed=1 AND IF(s.user_id IS NULL,CONCAT('device:',s.device_id),CONCAT('user:',s.user_id))=#{subject} AND t.user_text IS NOT NULL AND t.user_text != '' AND r.spoken_text IS NOT NULL AND r.spoken_text != '' AND t.id > p.context_reset_turn ORDER BY t.seq DESC LIMIT 32
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_long_term_memory(subject_key,memory_key,memory_type,content,source_session,source_turn,confirmation,confirmed_at,expires_at) SELECT #{subject},#{key},#{type},#{content},#{session},#{turn},#{confirmation},#{confirmed},#{expires} FROM learner_profile WHERE subject_key=#{subject} AND context_reset_turn < #{turn} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE memory_type=IF(VALUES(source_turn)>=source_turn,VALUES(memory_type),memory_type), content=IF(VALUES(source_turn)>=source_turn,VALUES(content),content), source_session=IF(VALUES(source_turn)>=source_turn,VALUES(source_session),source_session), confirmation=IF(VALUES(source_turn)>=source_turn,VALUES(confirmation),confirmation), confirmed_at=IF(VALUES(source_turn)>=source_turn,VALUES(confirmed_at),confirmed_at), expires_at=IF(VALUES(source_turn)>=source_turn,VALUES(expires_at),expires_at), source_turn=GREATEST(source_turn,VALUES(source_turn))
mapper.select: SELECT subject_key AS subjectKey,memory_key AS memoryKey,memory_type AS memoryType,content,source_session AS sourceSession, source_turn AS sourceTurn,confirmation,UNIX_TIMESTAMP(confirmed_at)*1000 AS confirmedAt,UNIX_TIMESTAMP(expires_at)*1000 AS expiresAt FROM agent_long_term_memory WHERE subject_key=#{subject} AND expires_at > #{now} ORDER BY confirmed_at DESC LIMIT 120
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM agent_long_term_memory WHERE subject_key=#{subject} AND memory_key=#{key}
DELETE FROM agent_long_term_memory WHERE subject_key=#{subject} AND LOCATE(#{topic},LOWER(content)) > 0
